summary: Matka/lottery game app with multiple markets (Kalyan, Milan, Time Bazar, Sridevi). Game times shifted 10 hours back, minimum deposit set to 20 Rs, and game results display added.
architectural_notes: App includes markets: Kalyan, Milan, Time Bazar, Sridevi with schedules and open/close status

existing_features.title: Display the latest declared game results for each market on the Market Lobby page. Each market card should show the most recent open number, close number, and jodi result beneath the market name and schedule.

Add a dedicated 'Results' section or page accessible from the main navigation that lists all markets with their historical game results in reverse chronological order (date, market name, open number, close number, jodi).
Add a React Query hook (e.g. useGameResultsQueries) to fetch all declared game results from the backend actor, with a 30-second polling interval consistent with the markets query.

new_feature_requests.summary: Shift all game times 10 hours back
Show game results for all markets
Add a backend function to store and retrieve declared game results per market, including open number, close number, and jodi values with a timestamp.
